title: Surveyor I
description:
Job Description

The Surveyor I is an entry or junior-level position for new graduates and/or those candidates with less than five (5) years of experience in an applicable industry. The Surveyor I, under a direct supervisor, performs work involving conventional surveying practices. The primary function is to develop the ability to effectively examine and report on vessels and other marine structures during and after construction relative to compliance with the applicable requirements for maintaining the vessel in Classification with ABS and meeting associated statutory and special service requirements related to Safety of Life at Sea, Loadline, Tonnage, Cargo Gear and Pollution Prevention Certification.

What You Will Do (with the assistance and guidance of an experienced ABS Surveyor):

  • Acts as a professional specialist for the organization in the application of related rules, regulations, requirements, concepts, principles, and processes.
  • Performs routine surveys on classed vessels, platforms, or other marine structures and at manufacturers for classification and compliance with statutory requirements.
  • Prepares technically accurate and timely reports of inspections and surveys performed.
  • Engages in contact with clients to resolve problems within areas of expertise.
  • Maintains survey files in an orderly and up-to-date manner in the area of responsibility.
  • Develops the skills necessary for the administration of office procedures and monitoring of business performance at an assigned port.
  • Through broader and more technically challenging work assignments, the individual must develop a thorough understanding of field operations, policies, methods, and procedures.

What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Qualifications from a tertiary institution within a relevant field of engineering or physical science (minimum two (2) years program); or
  • Qualifications from a marine or nautical institution and relevant seagoing experience as a certificated ship officer, and
  • Proficiency in the English language commensurate with the scope of statutory certification and services and, before assignment, with their future work.
  • Appropriate certification and/or licenses in areas of specialization may be required.

Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities

  • Ability to develop a working knowledge of ABS Rules, Guides, statutory regulations, and related instructions, as well as the ABS Employee Safety Policy.
  • Ability to read engineering plans and have a basic understanding of shipbuilding practices and vessel operations.
  • Ability to perform surveys in the prescribed format.
  • Knowledge of computer programs or software packages related to job responsibilities.
  • Knowledge of related technical interfaces required for group project work.
  • Knowledge of ships' engineering systems and machinery.
  • Ability to communicate, orally and in writing, pertinent information relative to assigned area of technical expertise.
  • Ability to analyze problems and propose solutions.
  • Responsiveness to customers and the ability to work well with others.
  • Ability to become familiar with the ABS Health, Safety, Quality, and Environmental Management Systems.

Physical Requirements:

  • Where allowed by local laws, a pre-employment physical examination is mandatory.
  • The role of surveyor/auditor requires sufficient physical strength, stamina, agility, and both visual and auditory acuity to perform the listed duties effectively.
  • The ability to climb vertical ladders up to nine meters and navigate steep steps is essential.
  • Shall be capable of working at heights on various staging and lifting equipment.
  • Shall be able to maneuver in tight spaces and work inside confined areas for extended periods, including kneeling and crawling.
  • The role may involve exposure to industrial environments, potential injury risks, extreme weather conditions, and demanding physical activities.
  • Shall be able to lift at least 25 lbs. / 11.34 kgs.
  • The use of small tools and the wearing of Personal Protective Equipment (PPE), in accordance with ABS safety procedures, may be required.
  • Where allowed by local laws, the surveyor will be required to successfully complete an annual physical that will recertify the individual can perform the physical actions required.

Reporting Relationships:

Will report to the Principal, Senior, or Surveyor-in-Charge of the assigned port. This position does not have any direct reports.

About Us

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times.

ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. Weâre at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting-edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Our commitment to safety, reliability, and efficiency is ever-present, guiding our clients to safer and more efficient operations.

Equal Opportunity

ABS Bureau is committed to the equal employment opportunity of its employees and prohibits discrimination against any employee or qualified applicant based on race, color, creed, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity, age, disability, marital status, sexual orientation, citizenship status or veteran status, or other non-work-related characteristics that may be protected under the law of the Federal Government or specific state employment laws.

ABS and Affiliated Companies (ABS) will not pay a fee to any third-party agency without a valid ABS Master Service Agreement (MSA) authorized and signed by Human Resources. Any resume, CV, application, or other forms of candidate submission provided to any employee of ABS without a valid MSA on file will be considered property of ABS, and no fee will be paid.

title: Why do you want this new job
description:
No matter which side of the table youâve sat during interviews, youâve probably heard this question: âWhy do you want this new job?â

In the recent past, Iâve interviewed a few candidates and heard the following answers so far:

  • Iâm not learning much on the current job after itâs been 2-4 years.
  • Iâm looking for something that offers better work-life balance.
  • Iâm not really looking for a job. The recruiters got in touch and I thought Iâd discuss.
  • Iâm looking for more challenging work.

All of the above are valid answers. I think thereâs another perfectly valid answer that candidates seldom mention probably due to the gravity of the interview room situation. Iâve interviewed over a hundred candidates across different companies and am yet to find anyone that mentions: I am not happy with my current salary and benefits compared to my skills

Back to topic of answers. So, when someone answers that they are not learning new things on the job, obviously, youâd be curios to know why and how they have tried to change things. Unfortunately, most candidates simply mention that they are doing repeat work and thereâs not much to learn doing the same thing over and over again. This is where I start feeling a little uneasy. However, I understand that itâs a true statement. If youâre in a similar situation, hereâs some suggestion: read books, and write code based on what youâve read. Then, you can tell a much convincing story that, Iâve forced myself to learn new things and hereâs some proof, but I really want to apply the newly learned skills outside the scope of the âhello worldâ skills.

About work-life balance, I totally hear you. And if your current job doesnât suit what you need out of your life, itâs a perfectly valid reason to look for new opportunities. However, make sure youâre able to clearly set the expectation with your potential employer about what work-life balance means for you. For example, if you canât work over 40 hours a week, or must work from home one-two days a week, itâs best to discuss this even before an interview starts to ensure youâre a good match with the employer.

If you showed up at in interview just because a recruiter got in touch, Iâd say introspect first. Itâs possible that on our subconcious mind you have expectations that the potential of the new job offers you something that you donât get at the current job. So, instead of a passive asnwer that the you simply acted based on the recruiterâs invite, itâs much convincing to see if you can lay down one or two things that you expect from the new job that you donât get at the current job.

About looking for more challenge, it sounds like a cliche unless you can share examples of work that is of challenging to you. May be you like the challenge of using more complicated algorithms, may be you like dealing with a lot of data, may be you like supporting production emergencies, but thereâs gotta be something that you can explicitly mention as challenging. It helps employers to understand if theyâre able to provide you with enough challenge on the job.

Finally, if youâre looking for a new job because the current job isnât paying upto the level of your skills and contributions, make sure to communicate it clearly as well. With salaries and benefits, I find it much easier to work with people that know the actual $ figure thatâll make them happy instead of beating around the bush to create confusions all around. Just be confident and tell what makes you happy. If the employer can afford it, most likely theyâll want to get you onboard as a happy employee. If they canât afford it, theyâll do their best. The key here is to be explicit about what you want and be sure and confident about it.

In a nutshell, when you walk into an interview itâs yours to lose. The potential employer is investing their time and resources and would rather have you hired than having to interview other candidates. As long as you are able to justify why you want the new job, theyâll be quite accommodating.

title: Head of Security
description:
Tremendous is the global platform built for businesses to send payoutsâgift cards and moneyâto anyone, anywhere, instantly. We're trusted by 20,000+ organizations, from startups to giants like Atlassian, MIT, and United Way, to reach millions of recipients worldwide.

We're profitable and growing without outside investors. We're fully remote, with a high-documentation, low-meeting culture that leaves more time for the work that mattersâand for your life outside it. Our employee NPS sits in the high 80s.

We move billions of dollars through our systems. That makes security existential, and it's why we're making our first dedicated security hire.

About The Role

You'll be our first Head of Security. There's already a real foundation hereâbug bounty, pen tests, automated code and configuration scanning on the production and code side, phishing simulations on the people side. Youâll add to it across access and identity, SecOps and monitoring, incident response, vendor security, employee security practices, and policy. You'll own the whole posture.

This is a player-coach role. Early on, you'll do the scoping and the hands-on work yourself; this is not a role where you direct from above. As the work demands it, we're fully prepared to build a team hereâand we're looking to you to define what that team should be and when.

You'll report to the VP of Engineering, Tremendous' most senior technical leader. We've deliberately placed security with Engineering so you're set up to drive real implementation fastâembedded with the people whose work you're securing, not siloed in a compliance function. As the security function matures, we'll revisit this.

What You'll Do

  • Own Tremendous' security posture end-to-end, partnering with our engineering team on production infrastructure and code security.
  • Assess where we have gaps, prioritize them, and tackle our highest-leverage gaps first. Weâll have opinions, but you own the prioritization and implementation.
  • Treat incident response as core, not afterthought. We may not be able to prevent a breach, but your job is making sure it's small, contained, and that we know exactly what to do.
  • Drive security as a cultural shift across the companyâintroducing controls incrementally, working with teams rather than over them. "Yes, and," not "no."
  • Lead our AI-security posture. We invest heavily in AI tooling; your job is to manage that risk and enable it, not to ban it.
  • Define when and how to staff up the security function, and hire your own team.

What You'll Bring

  • Real, hands-on security experience at a company that scaledâideally as an early security hire who grew with the business through high growth.
  • Deep experience in at least one core security domainâproduct/production security, security operations, or access/identity and policyâwith enough range to reason across the others. You defined the security posture, not just executed someone elseâs playbook.
  • An engineer's mindset. You reach for code to solve problems and can read our codebase and understand our infrastructure (Ruby on Rails; TypeScript + React; PostgreSQL; Google Cloud). You won't write much day-to-day, but you're not lost in the code.
  • Judgment over checklists. You can explain the actual risk of a given decision, hold a firm line where it matters, and give ground where "best practice" doesn't apply to us or real business need pulls the other way. You can hold your own in a debate about whether to open up broad data access for AI tooling.
  • Bedside manner. You drive hard change by bringing the team around to your point of view, rather than just telling them no. Engineers and the rest of the company want to work with you.
  • Experience building or co-building a small security team is a plus.
  • Fintech, payments, or regulated-industry experience is a plus.

What's Cool About The Role

  • You define the function. First security leader, with the budget for the required tools and team.
  • A real mandate. The push for this hire comes straight from the founders.
  • We invest in your tools. Everyone has a $5k/month budget for AI tools. Use it.
  • Competitive pay and equity. Base salary $250,000â$330,000, plus meaningful equity.
  • Fully remote. Work from anywhere in the Americas.
  • Great culture. Read more about how we work in our public handbook.

Compensation Range: $250K - $330K

The Clinical Coordinator Department Manager oversees the Clinical Coordination team responsible for maintaining accurate, appropriately filled provider schedules across all markets. This role provides leadership, operational oversight, training, workload management, process improvement, and cross-department collaboration to support consistent scheduling performance.

This leader sets daily and weekly priorities, delegates work, holds the team accountable, monitors current and upcoming schedule health, and identifies risks before they impact provider days. The manager ensures accepted treatment and unscheduled new-patient backlogs are actively worked and that scheduling barriers are tracked and escalated to the appropriate owner.

Team Leadership & Performance Management

  • Knowledge: Strong understanding of medical/dental workflows, provider scheduling, multi-facility coordination, pre-med & medical clearance processes, insurance verification, lab case coordination, and multi-facility scheduling

title: Data Analyst Assistant
description:
About the role
 The Data Analyst Assistant role is central to our current engagement with a Dubai-based investment firm that requires precise data handling and clear visualization. This position provides the quantitative groundwork that allows our principals to form a view on complex corporate governance and strategy questions. We need an assistant who can organize messy data sets into logical structures that reveal the health and performance of a holding company.

About Arabian Private Holdings
 Arabian Private Holdings was founded on the principle that many critical business problems do not fit the traditional large-firm consulting model. A board facing a succession question or a family group weighing a capital injection does not need a team of twelve associates and a hundred-page methodology deck. They need experienced partners who can sit with a problem, form a rigorous view, and defend it. We take on a limited number of mandates to ensure that every client receives direct attention from the principals who are actually accountable for the outcome. Our work covers corporate strategy, governance, and operating model efficiency for some of the most significant family groups, listed corporations, and government entities in the region. We focus on clarity over complexity. We operate as a remote firm, choosing to prioritize the quality of our analysis and the strength of our relationships over traditional office overhead or aggressive growth targets.

What you will do
  • Collect and organize financial and operational data from various portfolio companies for a Dubai-based investment.
  • Clean and validate data sets to ensure accuracy before they are used in client presentations.
  • Build simple, effective spreadsheets that track performance indicators for large holding companies.
  • Assist in drafting reports that translate numbers into clear written arguments for our principals.
  • Monitor industry trends and perform basic market research to support ongoing strategic mandates.
  • Maintain internal records to ensure that historical client data is easily accessible and correctly categorized.
  • Prepare charts and graphs that simplify complex financial structures for board-level reviews.
  • Support the audit of corporate governance documents by cross-referencing quantitative findings with qualitative reports.


What we are looking for
  • A clear understanding of basic statistics and a logical approach to problem-solving.
  • Proficiency in spreadsheet software with an ability to manage large amounts of information without errors.
  • Strong written skills and the ability to explain what a set of numbers means in plain English.
  • Curiosity about how large corporations and family groups operate in different sectors.
  • Precision in your work, where you check your own calculations before submitting them for review.
  • A degree or ongoing studies in a quantitative field such as economics, finance, or mathematics.


How we work
 We operate as a fully remote firm, which means we rely on clear documentation and asynchronous communication. Because our work involves sensitive mandates for high-profile clients, we maintain a high standard of professional conduct and data security. You will work closely with a principal who provides direct mentorship and expects you to form your own view on the data you analyze. We do not value long hours for the sake of appearances. Instead, we focus on the rigor of the output and the clarity of the logic. This remote model allows us to hire individuals based on their intellectual capability rather than their physical location, ensuring we can provide the best possible advice to our clients.

What the role offers
  • A paid entry-level position with a competitive compensation package for the current market.
  • Direct exposure to high-level corporate strategy and governance mandates.
  • Mentorship from experienced principals who have managed some of the largest holding companies in the region.
  • The flexibility of a permanent, full-time role that is entirely remote.
  • Practical experience in forming a rigorous view on business performance and portfolio health.

title: Data Entry Administrator
description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

description:
Type: Full time

Salary: Location-dependent (UK: Â£30,000âÂ£35,000 GBP / Canada: CAD $48,000â$57,000) + share options

Location: UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only)

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

We boost efficiency, improve resource utilisation, and increase project profitability - while promoting a healthy work/life balance.

Weâre proud to be one of the leaders in our category, trusted by customers in over 100 countries - including top creative agencies like Publicis, TBWA, Grey, BBH, and M&C Saatchi, as well as household names like NASA, Accenture, CNN, Kraft Heinz, and the NHS. They rely on Resource Guru to manage one of their most valuable assets - their peopleâs time.

Weâre a small, fully remote team based across the UK and Europe. We collaborate mainly via Slack, with occasional meetups to connect, plan, and celebrate. See if this is the right place for you.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

  • A big part of this role is making sure customers feel heard, understood and helped. We care about support that is accurate and efficient, but also warm, human and thoughtful.

What Weâre Looking ForEssential experience

  • 1-3 yearsâ experience in online customer support, ideally for a B2B SaaS or similar software company
  • Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to explain things clearly, simply and warmly
  • A calm, patient and empathetic approach to helping customers
  • Good attention to detail, especially when dealing with billing, account or technical questions
  • A practical approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Confidence learning new software tools and understanding how web-based products work
  • Some familiarity with basic technical concepts such as browsers, cache, cookies, internet connection issues and permissions
  • The ability to work independently in a remote team and manage your time well
  • A collaborative and conscientious attitude and willingness to share useful customer feedback with product, engineering and the wider team
  • Comfort with asynchronous communication and keeping written conversations clear, concise and on track

You donât need to be a developer, but you should be curious about technology and comfortable investigating how things work.

Bonus (not required)

It would be a bonus if you have experience with any of the following:

  • Supporting a SaaS product

Oula Health is a venture-backed, midwifery-led maternity and GYN care company building the next generation of women's healthcare. The Role

At Oula, our product doesn't sit alongside our EHR â it integrates directly into it. Every product and engineering decision has downstream consequences for how our EHRs are configured, and every EHR configuration decision shapes what's possible on the product side. Someone has to hold both at once.

We're looking for a technically-minded Product Manager to own and evolve our core technology stack â including our EHR, patient portal, and care management platform. This role sits at the intersection of product, operations, and health system integration, serving as the internal and external subject matter expert on our EMR and the primary lead for health system EHR integrations.

You'll manage the day-to-day health of our tech stack, partnering closely with both internal teams and external health system stakeholders to ensure our systems run smoothly and our integrations deliver. You can sit with a midwife and understand why a clinical template matters, then turn around and write a bug ticket that engineering can actually action, then build the SOP so the next market launch doesn't require you to be in the room. Data & Reporting

What You Bring

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you've audited our current Athena configuration, identified gaps, and have a remediation plan. You understand the bug triage process well enough to have improved it. You've met your counterparts at every health system partner and know what's coming for the next Epic integration.

ROAR is redefining hydration for a new generation. In a category that has become overly serious and hardcore performance obsessed, ROAR stands for something different: hydration that is expressive, effortless, and rooted in real life. Built for people who move, connect, and live life out loud, ROAR delivers complete hydration with vitamins, antioxidants, and electrolytes - all with just 20 calories and 3g of sugar or less per bottle.


More than a beverage, ROAR is a cultural signal - bright, approachable, and fun. It rejects the intensity and rules of traditional hydration in favor of something more human: joy, spontaneity, and the kind of movement that doesnât need a scoreboard. This role is responsible for leading all sales activities across grocery customers in the New York Metro area, including new business development, key account management, and executing data-driven strategies to expand market share and increase brand awareness.


The ideal candidate brings a proven track record of scaling high-growth brands profitably, with experience managing both established and emerging grocery retailers, as well as partners. title: Sales & Marketing Director
description:
The main purpose of the Sales & Marketing Director is to own and lead the company's entire revenue generation function by overseeing both Sales and Marketing as one unified department. You will be responsible for developing, executing, and optimizing strategies that generate qualified leads, improve sales performance, and drive sustainable revenue growth for Hustler Marketing.

This includes taking full ownership of the sales and marketing funnel, from generating the first client touchpoint to closing new business, while ensuring that every initiative, campaign, and sales process contributes to predictable and scalable growth. You will oversee lead generation, sales strategy, marketing channels, pipeline management, conversion optimization, team development, and departmental performance.

During your first phase in the role, you will audit our existing sales and marketing operations, identify opportunities for improvement, and personally lead key initiatives to rebuild and strengthen our growth engine. As the function matures, you will recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing Sales and Marketing team while delegating execution and maintaining strategic oversight.

The Sales & Marketing Director will report directly to Company Leadership while working collaboratively with the Service Department and other cross-functional teams.

About The Role

Mission Statement

The primary mission of our Sales & Marketing Director is to build a predictable, scalable, and high-performing growth engine that consistently generates qualified leads and converts them into long-term clients.

You will be responsible for ensuring that our marketing efforts generate a steady pipeline of opportunities while continuously improving our sales processes, qualification standards, and closing rates. Through strategic leadership, commercial insight, and operational excellence, you will align both departments toward one common objective: sustainable revenue growth.

As the company continues to grow, you will build and lead a best-in-class Sales and Marketing function that continuously improves acquisition performance, expands our market presence, and strengthens Hustler Marketing's position as the leading retention marketing agency for ecommerce brands.

General Responsibilities

  • Owning the entire sales and marketing funnel from lead generation through to signed contracts and new client acquisition
  • Developing and executing the company's overall sales and marketing strategy in alignment with business growth objectives
  • Auditing existing sales and marketing processes, identifying operational gaps, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement, and implementing effective solutions
  • Building predictable and scalable lead generation systems across multiple acquisition channels, including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, paid acquisition, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Ensuring a consistent flow of qualified leads that supports the company's revenue targets
  • Improving sales performance by optimizing lead qualification, sales processes, pipeline management, and conversion rates
  • Personally leading strategic sales initiatives and key opportunities during the initial rebuild phase while remaining actively involved in high-value deals when required
  • Building, recruiting, developing, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams as the departments continue to scale
  • Managing departmental budgets, hiring plans, resource allocation, and channel investment decisions to maximize return on investment
  • Establishing clear KPIs, performance metrics, and reporting systems across both Sales and Marketing functions
  • Monitoring pipeline health, lead generation performance, conversion rates, customer acquisition costs, revenue forecasting, and overall commercial performance
  • Presenting regular performance reports, strategic recommendations, and revenue forecasts to Company Leadership
  • Working closely with the Service Department to ensure alignment between client expectations, sales commitments, and service delivery
  • Collaborating with internal stakeholders to continuously improve client acquisition, onboarding, and long-term client success
  • Identifying new market opportunities, strategic partnerships, and innovative growth initiatives that contribute to the company's long-term expansion
  • Continuously researching industry trends, competitor activity, ecommerce developments, and emerging marketing strategies to maintain Hustler Marketing's competitive advantage
  • Developing scalable processes, documentation, and operational frameworks that improve departmental efficiency and long-term growth
  • Creating a culture of accountability, ownership, continuous improvement, and commercial excellence across both Sales and Marketing teams
  • Participating in leadership meetings and contributing to the overall strategic direction of the company
  • Supporting other departments with commercial insights and strategic initiatives whenever required
  • Directly reporting to Company Leadership

Position Specs

  • Full-time commitment while meeting our general availability for office hours
  • An average of 140 tracked hours per month consistently
  • Fixed-rate monthly salary paid in USD, with uncapped performance-based commission tied to closed revenue
  • Receive contractor status after signing our non-disclosure agreement
  • Exclusivity agreement (nullifying the possibility to work in a position of a similar nature while working for Hustler Marketing)
  • Committing to a 30-day notice period after the first two months (with the first two months being the trial-and-adaptation period paid at full rate)
  • Regular performance reviews every 9-12 months, with the first one being after 3-6 months
  • Re-evaluation of the role and workload after 6-12 months
  • Fully remote position with a flexible work schedule
  • Senior leadership position with direct ownership of Sales and Marketing strategy, budget, channels, and hiring

Requirements

About You

Profile

The ideal candidate is a commercially driven leader with extensive experience building, leading, and scaling both sales and marketing functions. You have successfully owned revenue targets, developed high-performing teams, and implemented systems that generate predictable business growth.

You are equally comfortable developing long-term commercial strategy and personally executing critical initiatives when necessary. You understand that during periods of growth or transformation, leadership means rolling up your sleeves, solving problems directly, and establishing the systems that others will later scale.

You have significant experience working within a digital agency or SaaS business serving ecommerce brands and understand the unique challenges of selling performance-based marketing services. You are highly analytical, data-driven, and focused on measurable business outcomes, using performance metrics to continuously optimize every stage of the customer acquisition funnel.

The right person is entrepreneurial, accountable, decisive, and capable of balancing strategic leadership with hands-on execution in a fast-paced, fully remote environment.

Key Requirements

  • At least 5 years of experience leading Sales, Marketing, or Revenue functions with direct ownership of commercial results
  • Proven experience building, scaling, and leading high-performing Sales and Marketing teams
  • Demonstrated ability to personally drive revenue growth while also developing scalable commercial systems and processes
  • Significant experience working within a digital marketing agency or SaaS company serving ecommerce businesses (required)
  • Proven success generating qualified leads through multiple acquisition channels including SEO, outbound sales, partnerships, referrals, content marketing, and other growth initiatives
  • Strong sales experience with a proven track record of personally closing new business and managing high-value sales opportunities
  • Excellent understanding of sales pipeline management, lead qualification, conversion optimization, and revenue forecasting
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to measure funnel performance, interpret commercial data, and make data-driven decisions
  • Experience managing departmental budgets, hiring, resource planning, and operational performance
  • Excellent leadership, coaching, and people management skills with the ability to build high-performing remote teams
  • Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
  • Strong organizational skills, accountability, responsiveness, and ability to consistently meet deadlines
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams in a fully remote environment
  • Experience selling retention marketing services such as Email Marketing, SMS Marketing, or UGC services is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with Klaviyo, ecommerce marketing technology, and the broader ecommerce ecosystem is highly desirable
  • Existing relationships or network within the ecommerce or DTC industry is considered a strong advantage
  • Must possess excellent strategic thinking, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities
  • Must be available and responsive during office hours (Mondays to Fridays between 3-6 PM BCN time)
  • Must consistently work 30-35 hours per week (approximately 140 hours per month)
  • Must have a stable internet connection and a laptop or desktop computer capable of attending virtual meetings
  • Must be open to receiving constructive feedback while also providing effective coaching and feedback to team members

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure
description:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Team

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. Every layer of this platform exists to make it easier for a homeowner to hire an Angi Pro, on one certified source of truth that people and AI agents can trust equally.

The team's strategy is built around one idea: this platform should feel like a self-service product, not a ticket queue, for the engineers and analysts who depend on it, and increasingly for the AI agents who depend on it too. Angi is moving toward AI agents as a normal way of building and operating, and every agent that touches company data comes through this platform first.

This role stewards that platform's product direction.

What You'll Do

Product Management

  • Manage governed platform access - give engineers, analysts, and services safe, auditable access to shared data, and make the safe path the easy path.

  • Streamline orchestration and scheduling - bring fragmented scheduling tools together into one system every team reaches for by default, and use AI-assisted tooling to migrate jobs faster, with less manual engineering effort.

  • Drive data ingestion and replication - define what self-service ingestion looks like for teams who want to bring their own data onto the platform, and build toward that.

  • Oversee legacy system retirement - close out systems that are no longer the source of truth, with clear ownership handed off at every step.

  • Optimize compute cost efficiency - find where cost comes from habit rather than real need, and bring it down without anyone losing the developer experience they rely on.

  • Advance compute strategy diversification - help move the platform toward a storage layer that works with more than one compute engine, so each workload runs on the engine built for it.

  • Build the platform's AI-ready substrate - make agentic workflows safe by default, with the same governed access and audit trail for an agent as for a person.

Execution and Individual Contribution

  • Use AI agents in your own daily work, set clear norms so the engineers and peers around you feel safe experimenting with agents and agentic workflows.

  • Protect the team's focus and drive real rigor without micromanaging how the work gets done. Steward outcomes, not tasks.

  • Build trust across engineering, domain teams, and leadership through empathetic, transparent, and clear communication when addressing complex challenges.

  • Work closely with Data Engineering's other delivery teams - Data Mesh Enablement and Managed Data Products - and with the team building Angi's agentic workflows, toward one overall technical strategy.

Who You Are

  • Five or more years of product management experience on a data or infrastructure platform team, where you stewarded technical roadmaps directly.

  • Comfortable reading system architecture and pipeline dependencies well enough to make real sequencing calls with engineering.

  • A record of taking cross-team migrations and retirements all the way to done, not just to a plan.

  • Transparent about areas of growth and open to learning, rather than presenting incomplete information as fully resolved under pressure.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience weighing compute cost against performance and developer experience, and driving that tradeoff to a decision rather than just planning around it.

  • Working knowledge of how AI agents consume data and tools differently from people, and judgment on when a vendor's own agent layer already covers a need.

  • A proactive approach to navigating and understanding new technical systems, key contacts, and open questions independently.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from €90,000 - 120,000, commensurate with experience and qualifications.

  • Hybrid work environment and home office set-up allowance.

  • Temporary work from abroad policy.

  • Regular team and social events.

At SAP Fioneer, we’re not just building software — we’re redefining what’s possible in financial services. As a global fintech innovator, we empower banks and insurers to run smarter, faster, and more flexibly with cloud-native solutions built on SAP’s trusted foundation.

We’re growing fast — and we’re looking for a Senior Manager Group Accounting & IFRS (m/f/d) who is as passionate about precision as about progress. If you’re an expert in IFRS and HGB, thrive on complex revenue models, and want to make an impact in a high-growth, high-tech environment, we want to meet you!

Requirements

What You’ll Do

  • Drive the month-end, quarter-end, and year-end close processes for revenue and related accounts, ensuring timely and accurate results. 
  • Lead the end-to-end process of revenue recognition for software licenses, SaaS, and professional services, ensuring compliance with IFRS 15 and local GAAP for 20 countries. 
  • Prepare, review, and analyze financial statements (balance sheet, P&L, cash flow) under both IFRS and HGB, ensuring compliance and transparency. 
  • Take ownership of group reporting, consolidating results and coordinating the activities that power both internal decisions and external disclosures. 
  • Build and evolve accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls that keep our financial reporting rock-solid. 
  • Author technical accounting memos and documentation that stand up to audit scrutiny. 
  • Manage internal and external audits with confidence and clarity, serving as the primary point of contact and owning the resolution of accounting and reporting matters. 
  • Continuously improve financial systems and processes, with a focus on automation, efficiency, and scalability in a cloud-first environment. 
  • Be a trusted advisor on financial reporting topics across the business. 

What You Bring

  • A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field — CPA, ACCA, or equivalent is a big plus. 
  • 6+ years of experience in accounting, ideally in the software or professional services space. 
  • Deep knowledge of IFRS (especially IFRS 15) and HGB — and the ability to apply it in real-world, fast-moving scenarios. 
  • Strong experience in financial statement preparation, group reporting, and consolidation. 
  • Experience with SAP ERP, preferably S/4 HANA, and a passion for leveraging technology to improve processes. 
  • Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the confidence to communicate complex topics clearly. 
  • Fluent in English and German. 

Benefits

Why SAP Fioneer?

  • Be part of a scale-up with enterprise roots — combining the agility of a startup with the stability of SAP.
  • Work on cutting-edge financial solutions that are transforming the industry.
  • Enjoy a flexible hybrid work model, competitive compensation, and a culture that values innovation, ownership, and collaboration.
  • Join a team of smart, driven, and genuinely nice people who love what they do.

title: DevOps Engineer Application Management Services (m/w/d)
description:
Wir suchen

Du möchtest nicht nur Pipelines betreiben, sondern komplette Betriebs- und Deploymentplattformen gestalten? Du möchtest Verantwortung für produktive Kundenumgebungen übernehmen und moderne DevOps-Praktiken vom Build bis zum Rollout umsetzen?

Wir betreiben und entwickeln für unsere eitco Lösungen im Umfeld der gesetzlichen Unfallversicherung moderne DevOps-Plattformen und unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Betrieb, führen Rollouts durch und übernehmen den Third-Level-Support. Dabei setzen wir konsequent auf Automatisierung, Infrastructure as Code und GitOps.

Betriebssysteme

Warum Du zu EITCO kommen solltest?

Bei uns betreibst du nicht nur einzelne Systeme. Du arbeitest an einer Plattformlandschaft, die vom Quellcode über CI/CD, Konfigurationsmanagement und Infrastruktur bis hin zum produktiven Betrieb reicht. Wir automatisieren konsequent, entwickeln eigene Puppet-Module, betreiben Kubernetes-Plattformen nach GitOps-Prinzipien und führen jedes Jahr zahlreiche Rollouts in produktiven Kundenumgebungen durch. In unserem Umfeld werden DevOps-Ingenieure zu echten Full-Stack-Engineers für den Betrieb moderner Anwendungen.

Was erwartet dich bei uns?

  • Ein erfahrenes DevOps-Team mit hoher technischer Expertise
  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten statt Ticket-Abarbeitung
  • Moderne Technologien und die Möglichkeit, neue Themen aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Direkter Einfluss auf Architektur-, Betriebs- und Automatisierungskonzepte
  • Abwechslungsreiche Projekte in unterschiedlichen Kundenumgebungen

  • Kollegiales Umfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

Dein Profil

Must-have

  • Erfahrung im Linux-Umfeld
  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und Infrastructure as Code
  • Verständnis moderner DevOps-Prinzipien
  • Spaß an nachhaltigen Lösungen und eigenverantwortlichem Arbeiten
  • Tiefere Kenntnisse in mindestens einem der Bereiche:
    • Puppet / bolt
    • PostgreSQL
    • Kubernetes / CAPI
    • Linux Administration
  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und gute Englischkenntnisse
Nice-to-have

  • Erfahrung mit Shell-Scripting (Bash oder PowerShell)

  • Erfahrung in regulierten oder sicherheitskritischen Umgebungen 


Warum wir?

Deine Chance – jetzt und für die Zukunft: 

  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Arbeite vor Ort in einem unserer modernen Büros oder flexibel am mobilen Arbeitsplatz daheim.
  • Teamspirit: Erlebe eine (Familien-) freundliche, wertschätzende Arbeitsatmosphäre im Unternehmen und deinem Team.

  • Immer up-to-date: Unser monatlicher OpenFriday mit Beiträgen aller Mitarbeitenden (standortübergreifend) und gemeinsamen Frühstück hält dich auf dem Laufenden.

title: Werkstudent Patient Operations (m/w/d)*
description:

Du willst, dass sich jeder Patient bei Bloomwell rundum gut aufgehoben fühlt, und behältst dabei auch die Kennzahlen und Prozesse im Blick, die dahinterstehen? Dann komm zu Bloomwell. Wir sind eines der führenden Health-Tech Unternehmen im Bereich medizinisches Cannabis mit der Mission, Patienten den Zugang zur Therapie so einfach wie möglich zu machen. Digital, patientenzentriert und schnell wachsend.
Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Patient Operations betreust du unsere Patienten über Livechat und Tickets, sorgst mit einem geschulten Blick für Qualität für einen exzellenten Customer Care und arbeitest dabei eng mit Product, Tech und weiteren internen Teams zusammen, um unsere Prozesse laufend zu verbessern.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Betreuung unserer Kunden über Livechat und unser Ticketing-System: eigenständige Lösung von Anliegen, bei komplexeren Themen Einbindung der richtigen Fachabteilungen, sowie Sicherstellung unserer Erreichbarkeit
  • Management der Bestellungen aus unserem Online-Shop
  • Qualitätssicherung im Customer Care: Chats und Tickets prüfen, Feedback geben und in Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Schnittstellen an der Weiterentwicklung unseres Qualitäts-Konzeptes sowie relevanter KPIs mitwirken

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product, Tech und weiteren internen Teams, um die Customer Experience und Customer Journey stetig zu verbessern

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise, auch bei wiederkehrenden Aufgaben
  • Freude am Umgang mit Kennzahlen sowie erste Erfahrung mit Excel oder vergleichbaren Tools
  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sowie gute Englischkenntnisse


Warum wir?

Du gestaltest von Tag eins an aktiv mit, in einem wachsenden Markt, mit flachen Hierarchien und echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Keine langsamen Strukturen, sondern kurze Wege und eine offene Kultur, in der deine Ideen zählen.

title: Senior Scaled Enablement Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Why we need you

Maltego helps organisations uncover complex relationships and connections across people, organisations, infrastructure, and digital assets. Our platform is used by investigators, security professionals, law enforcement agencies, and enterprises worldwide to accelerate investigations and make better decisions with connected data. As we continue to grow, we're expanding our Customer Enablement team to help more customers achieve value at scale. 
We're looking for a Senior Scaled Enablement Manager to design and lead scalable customer enablement programmes that help customers successfully adopt and expand their use of Maltego products. This role sits at the intersection of customer enablement, programme management, customer education, and product adoption. You'll create repeatable experiences that enable hundreds of customers to learn, adopt, and realise value through webinars, cohort programmes, workshops, office hours, self-service content, and usage-driven interventions. 
Rather than working with a small portfolio of strategic accounts one-to-one, your focus will be on creating programmes and systems that deliver meaningful outcomes across an entire customer segment. You'll play a key role in shaping how Maltego scales customer success and adoption as we continue to grow.


What to expect

  • Own the scaled enablement motion, designing live, repeatable programmes that drive product adoption, engagement, and value realisation.
  • Build and maintain a cohort and enablement roadmap aligned with customer needs, product priorities, and business objectives.
  • Develop and optimise repeatable scaled customer journeys that support onboarding, adoption, expansion, and re-engagement at scale.
  • Plan and deliver webinars, workshops, cohort-based training programmes, office hours, and other one-to-many customer learning experiences.
  • Create and maintain high-quality enablement content, including training materials, guides, playbooks, videos, and knowledge base resources.
  • Leverage AI and automation tools to improve programme design, content creation, customer insight generation, and operational efficiency across scaled enablement initiatives.
  • Analyse customer engagement and product adoption data, using AI-assisted insights where appropriate, to identify trends, opportunities, and targeted intervention strategies.
  • Measure and improve programme effectiveness using customer feedback, usage insights, and business performance metrics.
  • Partner closely with Account Managers, Customer Enablement SMEs, Product Management, Marketing, and Operations teams to deliver a seamless customer experience.
  • Define and evolve scalable operating models, processes, and best practices that enable customer success programmes to grow efficiently with the business.


Your profile in short

Required Qualifications (Must Have)

  • Minimum 5 years' experience in Customer Success, Customer Enablement, Customer Education, Customer-facing Programme Management, Product Adoption, Training, or a similar customer-facing SaaS role.
  • Experience designing, delivering, and improving scalable customer programmes, including webinars, cohorts, workshops, office hours, or other one-to-many formats in a SaaS or technology environment.
  • Strong presentation, facilitation, written communication, and content development skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects and stakeholders in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate customer insights and usage data into actionable adoption strategies.
  • Proven ability to build trusted relationships and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.
  • Professional proficiency in English (written and spoken).

title: (Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany (m/f/d)
description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn about our Product & Tech team!

Deine Position

Heartbeat AI is our energy optimisation platform that always provides our customers with the cleanest and cheapest energy. As the (Senior) Go-to-Market Scaling Manager - Germany, your first focus is optimising the performance, positioning, and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within our largest and most established market while adding new products to it and making sure our new customer-facing features get seen. You will take ownership of what's already working and what isn't, fine-tuning pricing, packaging, and go-to-market execution while working closely across Product, Tech, Sales, and Marketing to keep the German market performing at its full potential.

  • You own the performance and monetisation of Heartbeat AI within the German market, working to continuously optimise what's already in place rather than build from zero.
  • You fine-tune pricing and packaging, identify where existing structures are leaving value on the table, and drive the changes needed to capture it.
  • You bring new positioning ideas to an already mature market, testing and validating fresh angles alongside the initiatives already running.
  • You develop a deep understanding of the unit economics behind Heartbeat AI in Germany, using that insight to shape monetisation strategy across pricing, packaging, and the broader product suite.
  • You work closely with Product, Tech, Marketing, and Sales stakeholders, translating technical constraints into commercial decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements.
  • You track performance across the German market, using data to spot where monetisation or positioning is underperforming and turning that into concrete action.
  • You operate with significant cross-functional influence, managing diagonally across tech, sales, and marketing to keep initiatives moving.
  • You report into the Go-to-Market Director, working closely with senior leadership to present performance updates and build the case for changes to positioning or monetisation strategy.

Dein Profil

  • You bring at least 5 years of experience in a similar commercial, product, or GTM role, ideally within the tech and energy industry.
  • You are confident optimising an already-established market, spotting where fine-tuning pricing, packaging, or positioning can unlock further performance.
  • You are structured by default and follow through without being asked: you manage multiple concurrent initiatives and dependencies without losing the thread, and own action items end to end.
  • You are ambitious and impact-driven, yet humble and a strong influencer in equal measure. You set a high bar for what "good" looks like, quickly credit the team and admit when something isn't working, and can bring sceptical stakeholders on board to inspire the cross-functional effort to scale the German market.
  • You have a strong grasp of unit economics and a genuine passion for how they drive monetisation decisions, and you can translate margin and cost-structure insights into concrete pricing and product strategy.
  • You are comfortable working closely with Tech, Sales and Marketing teams and fluent in both sales/marketing and technology language, translating technical trade-offs into business decisions and commercial priorities into technical requirements, without needing someone else to broker the conversation.
  • You are confident presenting to and working directly with executives and can turn data and KPIs into clear, decision-ready updates.
  • You are native in German and fluent in English (C1/C2), written and verbal.
  • Knowledge of and experience in the German energy market is clearly a plus, but not a must.

title: Founding AI Engineer @handly - 20VC backed
description:
Germany has about a million trade businesses. They do more than €700 billion of work a year, and they run almost all of it by hand: quotes in the evening, invoices on the weekend, payments chased between jobs.

For decades, the software built for them was made for desk workers. Forms, menus, dropdowns, buttons. None of it was made for people who are always on the go and only care about the outcome.

AI changes that. For the first time, the admin of a trade business can be done for the owner instead of by them.

We are building a business-in-a-box for the trades.

Tradespeople want outcomes done for them, with as little interaction with software as possible. handly takes care of leads, quotes, measurements, invoicing and payments, so they can focus on their craft, and is accountable for the result.

We started with roofers in Germany. Other trades are next.

Delivering outcomes is a much harder problem than delivering software. That is the job of an AI-native services company. Most of our vision has not been built yet, and we are looking for top-tier talent in Berlin to help us bring it to life.

We are a small, close-knit team in Berlin-Mitte, backed by 20VC, Stride and Base10. We build, experiment and move fast, and we have found creative ways to use AI in every part of the company: product, ops, go-to-market and admin.

about the role

This role is for engineers who want to push what AI can do for a real business. As our founding AI engineer, you'll have high agency to hone your skills with AI and solve hard real-world problems that bring delightful experiences to our partners.

The biggest opportunity at handly: we run the entire administration of our partners, rather than one vertical of their needs. That gives AI the room to take on large, autonomous tasks end to end, and gives us room to get very creative with what AI can do as we capture more and more channels of communication.

You will own AI products end to end, make the core product and technical decisions, and turn messy, real-world workflows into AI that does the work for our partners.

We are a small team working on:

  • modernizing the user experience of an underserved industry
  • reimagining workflows that have not changed in decades, with AI
  • moving from AI workflows to high-autonomy agents
  • capturing data and context from calls, emails, photos, documents and voice

Tasks

AI already runs in production across handly: intelligence on every customer call, automatic payment matching, a daily briefing for every partner. Some of the bigger projects you will contribute to or lead:

  • Quote generation. Turn voice notes, photos and documents from customers and architects into a six-figure quote, priced intelligently from the partner's own catalog.
  • Measurements. Measure buildings from satellite imagery, drone footage and public building data, without a site visit.
  • Back office in natural language. An MCP layer over the whole product, so partners can manage their back office in a chat.
  • Email intelligence. Capture intelligence from email threads and attachments, automate communication with clients and suppliers, and aggressive anti-phishing and spam protection.
  • Self-improving pipelines. Use every correction, edit and rejection to improve the next output.
  • Evals. Build the evaluation sets and benchmarks that gate every AI feature before it ships.

Requirements

  • Have 4+ years of full-stack engineering experience (exceptions apply for exceptional engineers)
  • You have shipped AI features that real users depend on, and continiously evloved them.
  • Strong full-stack TypeScript comfortable across backend, web and mobile.
  • Experience building evals, benchmarks and self-improving loops that automate research on AI capabilities.
  • Creative about capturing data and context (transcripts, photos, documents, voice) to improve AI features.
  • Strong prompt engineering: structured outputs, tool use, agents, and good judgment about when an LLM is the wrong tool.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. You lead your projects end to end and want to grow with the company.
  • Bonus: you have built your own fully functional AI side project. Send us your best one.

our tech stack

  • Full-stack TypeScript: Node.js, Express, Drizzle, Postgres
  • Web: React, Vite, React Query, Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Zod
  • Mobile: React Native, Expo, EAS, React Query
  • AI: Vercel AI SDK, promptfoo, OpenAI and Anthropic models
  • Building: we use AI extensively to build, with zero friction adopting the best tools, and we built a custom software factory that takes care of small tasks
  • Infra: AWS, PostHog, Sentry

what may not make you a good fit

  • you prefer a remote or hybrid setup
  • you want to be told exactly what to do
  • you mostly care about the tech, not the outcome for the customer
  • you want to work 9-5

Benefits

  • competitive compensation package, €80–110k + 0.4–0.7% equity
  • unlimited access to frontier models and our always-on software factory
  • as much responsibility as you want, flat hierarchy
  • fast loops and direct feedback from the people who use what you build
  • minimal meetings: we have plannings and demo Fridays, No stand-ups, we like to maximize our focus time.
  • a tight, ambitious team that enjoys building hard things together from the comfort of our office.
  • regular team outings: dinners, padel, events and movie nights
  • a modern, light-filled office in Berlin-Mitte and great vibes ^^

Process

  1. Intro with Ohan (30m)
  2. Technical Background with Kais (45m)
  3. AI Product Engineering Challenge (3-4h)
  4. On-site with the product team and our CEO Basti - white-boarding, product taste & culture (half-day)

That’s it! We’ll reach out with an offer.

Start date: ASAP

Location: Berlin only, in-office

title: Site Reliability Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Rolle

Du unterstützt uns dabei, die On-Premise-Cloud-Plattform von OVHcloud weiterzuentwickeln, zu betreiben und zu industrialisieren. Als Teil eines kleinen, erfahrenen Teams arbeitest du an unserer OpenStack-basierten Infrastruktur sowie am Kubernetes- und GitOps-Stack, auf dem unsere kundenorientierte Cloud-Plattform läuft. AI-Assisted Engineering ist dabei ein fester Bestandteil unserer täglichen Engineering-Praxis – von Spec-Driven Development über agentische Coding-Workflows bis hin zu Incident Response und Automatisierung. Die Plattform befindet sich aktiv im Aufbau, sodass du direkten Einfluss auf Architektur, Automatisierungsstrategie und den Einsatz von AI im Platform Engineering hast. Als Senior übernimmst du Ownership für deine Themen und gestaltest deinen fachlichen Schwerpunkt entlang deiner Stärken – mit Fokus auf Automation, Compute Lifecycle, Platform Engineering und AI Substrate.

Unser Tech Stack 🚀

· OpenStack · Kubernetes · KVM · Linux · Bare Metal · Ansible · Terraform · Go
· FluxCD / ArgoCD · Git· Python · Claude Code · Cursor · Agentic Coding Tooling

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst unsere OpenStack-basierte On-Premise-Cloud-Infrastruktur mit dem Ziel, komplette Cloud-Umgebungen hochautomatisiert auf Bare Metal ausrollen und in Betrieb nehmen zu können.

  • Du entwickelst und betreibst Infrastructure as Code mit Ansible und Terraform sowie unsere Kubernetes- und GitOps-Workflows mit FluxCD / ArgoCD - unterstützt durch LLMs, agentische Workflows und automatisierte Test- und Review-Prozesse.

  • Du verantwortest den Lifecycle unserer Compute-Infrastruktur - von Bare Metal, Firmware und Provisionierung bis zu Hypervisoren und virtuellen Compute Nodes. Dazu gehören unter anderem Patching, Migrationen, Host Evacuations, Capacity Rebalancing und die Automatisierung eines stabilen Plattformbetriebs.

  • Du entwickelst unser AI Substrate und unsere Self-Healing-Strategie weiter - von strukturierten Knowledge Bases und agentischen Workflows für Incident Triage und Capacity Planning bis hin zur schrittweisen Automatisierung heutiger Runbooks.

  • Du konzipierst Tests für Non-Regression, Performance und Security, dokumentierst und paketierst Lösungen und verbesserst die Plattform kontinuierlich anhand von Telemetrie, Betriebserfahrungen und Nutzerfeedback.

  • Als Senior Engineer bist du technische Ansprechperson und Sparringspartner für Kolleg rund um Automation, Platform Engineering und AI Tooling.

Was wir dir bieten

  • Eine Plattform im echten Build Mode mit viel Gestaltungsspielraum, sichtbarem Einfluss auf Architekturentscheidungen und einem erfahrenen Senior-Team, in dem Autonomie und Ownership zählen.

  • AI-Augmented Engineering als fester Bestandteil unserer Arbeitsweise - mit Claude Code und vergleichbaren agentischen Tools, Markdown-basierten Knowledge Bases und Raum, unsere Engineering-Praxis aktiv weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Außergewöhnlicher Teamspirit über alle Abteilungen und Ländergrenzen hinweg - wir leben #OneTeam.

  • Spannende Aufgaben in einem hochinnovativen und internationalen Umfeld mit modernsten Technologien.

  • 32 Urlaubstage, die sich mit zunehmender Betriebszugehörigkeit erhöhen.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Homeoffice-Möglichkeiten und eine sichere, unbefristete Anstellung mit markt- und leistungsorientierter Vergütung.

  • Arbeitgeberfinanzierte Altersvorsorge und ein attraktives Versicherungspaket.

  • OVHcloud übernimmt 50 % der Kosten für den öffentlichen Nahverkehr.

  • Bis zu 400 € jährlicher Zuschuss für Sportaktivitäten, zum Beispiel Fitnessstudio oder Sportkurse.

  • Attraktive Rabatte bei zahlreichen Shops und Unternehmen über Corporate Benefits.

  • Wir beteiligen uns am Leasing deines Cargo Bikes.

  • Regelmäßige Company Events sowie kostenlose Kalt- und Heißgetränke.

  • Du bringst mehrere Jahre praktische Erfahrung als SRE, Platform Engineer oder DevOps Engineer im Betrieb produktiver Infrastruktur mit und verfügst über fundierte Erfahrung mit OpenStack, Kubernetes und Linux, auch auf Bare Metal.

title: Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d)
description:
The role

We’re looking for a Senior Python Engineer, Platform Libraries (m/f/d) to join our team and play a key role in developing software that connects and translates lab equipment hardware interfaces, automates machines, and powers our next-generation automation platform. As a core team member, you will be working on cutting-edge technology, building software that bridges the gap between software and hardware, enabling seamless integration across various vendors.

Connectors are how we do it. Every instrument we bring online gets one, and every connector is built on our shared Python libraries: Bus, our Connector Development Kit, and the stack underneath them.

Our mission is to empower researchers and engineers by bridging the gap between lab equipment and cloud-based automation. Our customers are solving critical challenges like curing diseases, developing sustainable materials, and addressing global food security. We provide them with the tools to connect their devices, automate workflows, and unlock new possibilities in R&D.

Your mandate has two halves. Own the libraries as a product with real users, our own engineers today and external contributors later. And stay close enough to customer connector work that what you build is grounded in problems that actually exist.


Why you'll love this role

Your users are engineers. Your success lets other people ship connectors faster. That's a different craft from shipping features, and it's the one we're hiring for.

Real hardware, real failure modes. Instruments time out, return garbage, and arrive with documentation that's wrong. You'll debug against physical devices in our Munich workshop.


Open source on purpose. Our CDK and our standardization work (SiLA 2) are public. What you build gets used and criticized by people outside the company.


Senior scope, small team. You'll be the person who decides how connector engineering works here. No layer between you and that decision.


Your mission

1. The Builder: own the shared libraries

  • Own Bus, the CDK, and the core stack. Features, tests, CI, releases, and deprecations across the connectors already running in production.

  • Extract abstractions from real work. When the same pattern shows up in the third connector, it becomes a library feature. You're the one who notices, and the one who does it.

  • Make the docs good enough to remove yourself. An outside contributor should be able to build a connector on our libraries without a call.

  • Set the quality standard. You define what "tested" means before a connector reaches a customer, and you make it stick.

2. The Shipper: build connectors on real instruments

  • Ship production connectors end to end. Spec sheet, physical device, protocol, proof of connectivity, tested connector, live customer. Independently.

  • Reverse-engineer what isn't documented. Roughly half the instruments we touch have incomplete or wrong docs. Packet captures, trial and error, vendor calls.

  • Work with the workshop. Our Connector Factory team gets instruments development-ready. You take it from there.

  • Talk to the people who use it. Automation engineers and scientists at biotech and pharma customers. Their constraints shape what the libraries need next.


Your profile

  • Deep Python: 5+ years of writing production Python other people depend on. Async, typing, packaging, testing. You've designed APIs that other engineers built on, not just glue code.

  • You've debugged a real protocol against real hardware: gRPC, serial, TCP, OPC UA, CAN, USB. Which one matters less than having sat with a packet capture and a device that won't respond.

  • You ship without a spec: When the documentation is wrong, you reverse-engineer, instead of filing a vendor ticket and waiting. 

  • You build for other developers: An SDK, a library, an internal platform. Something where your job was making other engineers faster.

  • Located in Munich: The instruments are physically here at WERK1. 


Nice to have

  • SiLA 2, or another device abstraction and interoperability standard

  • Lab automation, scientific instruments, or a life science background

  • Open source maintainership with actual external contributors

  • C, C++, .NET, or Rust, for the vendor DLLs and drivers we end up wrapping

  • Docker, Kubernetes, edge deployment

  • German, for vendor conversations


Probably not a fit if

Better to say this now than in week 6.


  • Your Python is all APIs and databases and you've never debugged a physical device.

  • You'd want two quarters to redesign the library architecture before shipping a connector.

  • You like shipping integrations but have no appetite for going back afterwards to generalise, test, and document.
